name: agent-kit
description: HITL framework for AI-assisted IDEs — plan, handoff, staging→prod, memory loop, anti-slop. Stack skills via agent-kit add.

interface.longDescription: Mission Kit keeps a human in the loop for AI coding agents: plans with to-dos, a HANDOFF file that survives new chats, a staging-to-prod git routine with explicit operator gates, a memory loop for decisions and errors, and anti-slop rules. The agent-kit CLI installs the kit into a repository and stacks extra skills via agent-kit add.
